assumptions.project_name: Synthetic demonstration project (not a real project)
assumptions.other_disruption_assumption: No non-weather disruption is modelled; assumed 0 hours for demonstration.
assumptions.schedule_assumption: All 69 canonical WBS activities are scheduled sequentially in catalogue order for the configured number of weekdays; no dependencies, holidays other than the explicit list, or parallel work are inferred.
assumptions.productivity_assumption: Synthetic lost hours are deterministic functions of same-day observed station rainfall and mean temperature, activity sensitivity, and exposure. They are not historical measurements, causal estimates, or validated effects.
